item.title: Rebuilt this site; fact audit caught invented claims
item.description: This site went from a game-themed page to a professional portfolio. A planning model wrote the spec, a builder agent worked through it from a task board, and served screenshots were reviewed before it went live. The diagrams and charts are now 14 inline SVG figures, each with a data table.
item.content:encoded:
What changed: This site went from a game-themed page to a professional portfolio. A planning model wrote the spec, a builder agent worked through it from a task board, and served screenshots were reviewed before it went live. The diagrams and charts are now 14 inline SVG figures, each with a data table.

Why it matters: Every number on the site now traces to a source line: 380 numbers in all. A script measures diagram text on 23 pages at 3 screen widths. Rows under the 13px floor went from 18 to 0.

Result: Merged and live on 3 Oct 2026, with 0 failing rows on the text size check.

Lesson: A coordinator draft invented model names, metrics and certifications; the fact audit caught it and the pages were rebuilt. A reviewer agent on Gemini 3.7 Flash approved a build with visible defects, so agent approval is no longer final. One build fell back from Opus 5.5 to Sonnet 4.6.

Sources: K:t_d2253e4b, K:t_fe967bff, K:t_2e5cde57

item.title: Moved the agents from laptop to cloud server
item.description: Hermes Agent, the open-source framework my agents run on, moved from a Linux virtual machine on my MacBook Pro to a cloud server running Ubuntu. The model gateway (9Router, which sends each request to a model) and the provider sync now run as system services on that server.
item.content:encoded:
What changed: Hermes Agent, the open-source framework my agents run on, moved from a Linux virtual machine on my MacBook Pro to a cloud server running Ubuntu. The model gateway (9Router, which sends each request to a model) and the provider sync now run as system services on that server.

Why it matters: The agents keep working when the laptop is closed. Scheduled jobs and the daily progress report no longer depend on my machine being awake.

Result: The move is dated 20 Sep 2026 by the provider's billing record and the server's first boot log, not by memory. Gateway and sync were deployed as services on 21 Sep 2026.

Lesson: The date of this move rests on a billing record and a boot log rather than my memory. I now log every milestone to an append-only ledger with an ID before I write about it.

Sources: G:0009, G:0010, G:0011, G:0012
